title: Recovery of Paired T Cell Receptors from Single-cell Seq-Well Libraries
protocol: Dilute necessary buffers from the xGen kit and store extra at 4°C.
Bring diluted buffers to 37°C before use to ensure all salts dissolve.
Dilute pull-down probes ahead of time in multi-channel compatible format.
Mix TCRα and TCRβ probes together and dilute each to 1.5uM (total 3 uM).
Thaw both the 2x hybridization buffer and xGen buffer enhancer from the kit.
Bring thawed buffers to room temperature before use.
Mix Cot-1 DNA, hybridization buffer, and buffer enhancer as required for the experiment setup.
Mix 0.5 μL of WTA product with the master mix (for a total of 16 μL).
Incubate mixture at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Incubate the mixture at 95 degrees Celsius for 10 minutes.
Remove mixture to room temperature, and add 1 μL of pull-down probes mix. Vortex to mix, and centrifuge to collect liquid.
Incubate the mixture at 65 degrees Celsius for one hour to allow for hybridization of pull-down probes to WTA libraries.
Aliquot 50 μL of beads per sample into a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Place the tube on magnetic stand and allow for the beads to pellet.
Remove supernatant, and add equal volume of bead wash buffer into the tube.
Vortex to mix, and place back on the magnetic stand.
Repeat steps removing supernatant and adding bead wash buffer until fully washed.
Take tube off of magnet, and add equal volume of bead wash buffer.
Aliquot 50 μL of the mixture into PCR strip tubes.
Place tubes back on magnetic stands.
Remove the supernatant.
Add mixes from A into the prepared beads from B.
Vortex to mix.
Incubate mixture at 65 degrees for 45 minutes.
Intermittently vortex the mixture every 10 minutes.
Preheat Wash Buffer 1 (WB1) and Stringent Wash Buffer (SWB) at 65 degrees during incubation of C.
Aliquot at least 100 μL/sample of WB1 and 400 μL/sample of SWB (2x200 μL).
Aliquot buffers into PCR strip tubes for preheating on thermocycler/thermoshaker.
Wash hybridized beads at 65 degrees.
Add 100 μL of heated WB1 into each hybridized mixture.
Place the mixture onto a magnetic stand.
Aspirate the supernatant and remove mixtures from the magnetic stand.
Add 200 μL of heated SWB to each reaction and resuspend the bead pellets.
Incubate the mixture at 65 degrees for 5 minutes.
Place the mixture back on the magnetic stand, aspirate the supernatant, and repeat steps 4-6.
Aspirate the final wash of SWB.
Wash hybridized beads at room temperature.
Add 200 μL of room temperature WB1 into each reaction.
Vortex for 2 minutes to mix, spin to collect liquid, and place on magnetic stand.
Aspirate and add 200 μL of room temperature WB2.
Vortex for 1 minute to mix, spin to collect liquid, and place on magnetic stand.
Aspirate and add 200 μL of room temperature WB3.
Vortex for 30 seconds to mix, spin to collect liquid, and place on magnetic stand.
Aspirate and add 20 μL of water.
PCR amplify pull-down TCR products
Prepare a master mix per reaction:
Mix Kapa Hifi Hotstart Readymix 2X (Kapa Biosystems) with UPS(10uM) and water to make the following volumes: 12.5 uL of Kapa Hifi, 2 uL of UPS, and 8.5 uL of water.
Aliquot 5x 23uL of master mix for each reaction.
Add 2uL of mixture from F into each of the aliquots.
PCR amplify using the following conditions:
1 cycle at 95°C for 3 minutes.
25 cycles of 98°C for 40 seconds, followed by 67°C for 20 seconds, and finally 72°C for 1 minute.
1 cycle at 72°C for 5 minutes.
Hold the reaction at 4°C after amplification.
After amplification, pool all 5 PCR reactions (20uL for each sample) into a single tube to achieve a total of 100uL per sample.
Perform SPRI purification to remove all products < 1kbp.
Make two separate mixes (one for TCRα and one for TCRβ chain).
Mix 12.5 µL of Kapa Hifi Hotstart Readymix 2X.
Add 2.5 µL of TCRV-UPS2 TCRα or TCRβ at a concentration of 10uM.
Add 6 µL of water.
Aliquot 21 µL of the mastermix into PCR tubes per reaction.
Add 4 µL of TCR enrich product to each PCR tube for a total volume of 25 µL per reaction.
Perform primer extension at 95°C for 5 minutes.
Incubate at 55°C for 30 seconds.
Incubate at 72°C for 2 minutes.
Hold at 4°C.
Add 25 μL of water to each reaction to achieve a total volume of 50 μL.
Clean up using SPRI method and elute into 11 μL of water.
Amplify the primer-extension products using UPS2-N70x and UPS-mod-N50x primers.
Thaw UPS2-N70x and UPS-mod-N50x primers.
Dilute primers to a concentration of 10 uM.
Split each sample into 4 PCR reactions.
Prepare a master mix per reaction using Kapa HiFi HotStart Readymix 2X.
Amplify using 1 cycle at 95°C for 2 minutes.
Perform 9-18 cycles of 95°C for 30 seconds, then 60°C for 30 seconds, followed by 72°C for 1.5 minute.
Complete with 1 cycle at 72°C for 5 minutes.
Hold at 4°C.
Take 12.5 μL from each reaction and pool to make a total of 50 μL per sample.
SPRI clean as previously described.
Assess the size distribution and concentration of the final product using fragment analyzer and Kapa quant qPCR.
Prepare TE buffer in a 50 mL conical using sterile stock solutions (10 mM TrisNHCl, 1 mM EDTA).
Mix SeraNmag SpeedBeads and transfer 1 ml to a 1.5 ml microtube.
Place SpeedBeads on magnet stand until beads are drawn to magnet.
Remove supernatant with P200 or P1000 pipetter.
Add 1 ml TE to beads, remove from magnet, mix, return to magnet.
Remove supernatant with P200 or P1000 pipetter.
Add 1 ml TE to beads, remove from magnet, mix, return to magnet.
Remove supernatant with P200 or P1000 pipetter.
Add 1 ml TE to beads and remove from magnet. Fully resuspend and set microtube in rack (not on magnet stand).
Add 9 g PEGN8000 to a new 50 mL, sterile conical.
Add 10 ml 5 M NaCL or 2.92 g to the conical.
Add 500 μl 1 M TrisNHCl to the conical.
Add 100 μl 0.5 M EDTA to the conical.
Fill the conical to ~49 ml using sterile dH2O (by eye, go slowly).
Mix the conical for about 15 minutes until PEG goes into solution (solution should be clear upon sitting).
Add 27.5 μl Tween 20 to the conical and mix gently.
Mix 1 mL SpeedBead with TE solution.
Transfer the mixture to a 50 mL conical tube.
Fill the 50 mL conical tube to the 50 mL mark with dH2O if not already filled.
Gently mix the 50 mL conical tube until the contents appear brown.
Test the Serapure mixture against AMPure XP using aliquots of a DNA ladder (Fermentas GeneRuler).
Wrap the tested mixture in tin foil and store at 4°C.
Prep fresh aliquots of 80% EtOH.
Mix 2 µL GeneRuler with 18 µL dH2O.
Add 20 µL GeneRuler mixture to a volume of Serapure or AMPure, depending on the specific test objective.
Incubate the mixture for 5 min at room temperature.
Place the mixture on a magnet stand.
Remove the supernatant from the mixture.
Add 200 µL of 80% EtOH to the beads.
Incubate on the magnet stand for 1 min.
Remove the supernatant after incubation.
Add 200 µL of 70% EtOH to the beads.
Incubate on the magnet stand for 1 min.
Remove the supernatant after this step.
Place the beads on a 37°C heat block for 3-4 min until dry.
Rehydrate the dried beads with 20 µL dH2O.
Place the rehydrated mixture on a magnet stand.
Transfer the supernatant to a new tube.
Mix supernatant with 1 µL loading dye.
Electrophorese in 1.5 % agarose for 60 min at 100 V.
